authorization: Optimize the implementation and increase question quantity/diversity, keeping the cumulative CNY20 limit and compact figure/paper.
workload_scope: Same two schemas, M1/M3/M5 and all eleven independent changes. Six heldout questions per cell and one mandatory question per change; up to one further question per change under a predeclared cost gate.
memory_scope: ACE/AWM retain private agent A memory; G-Memory shares within the dataset run. A also performs source learning so private methods can use learned knowledge. Every question starts a new conversation.
feedback: All four planners receive the same bounded format of their own previous questions, answers, SQL, observations and binary correctness. ACE/AWM/G-Memory retain their published update algorithms; MAVRA retains native publication/maintenance. No gold SQL/value, hidden change label, or other method trace is exposed.
scenario_isolation: Each change starts from v1 data and post-heldout memory; all four memory implementations restore the same checkpoint boundary.
execution_order: ACE, AWM, G-Memory, MAVRA; datasets run in parallel, one agent task per cell. One matched run; adaptive extra count uses spending only.
failure_policy: Retain all attempts and incurred costs. Model errors/refusals count as incorrect. An infrastructure failure or budget-interrupted cell does not become a completed full-method result; incomplete matched blocks are separately reported.
reporting: Equal setting weights, then group means. Full common selected question bank, no incomplete method substitution. One run is not statistical-significance evidence. Include total cumulative spending and every discarded extra request.

baseline_sources.ace: ace-agent/ace@82709de; released no-ground-truth Reflector/Curator and playbook utilities, existing SQL tool adaptation
baseline_sources.awm: zorazrw/agent-workflow-memory@8c0ff8c; released prompts and online induction schedule, existing SQL tool adaptation
baseline_sources.gmemory: bingreeky/GMemory@7b581c5; unchanged official memory core and released MiniLM/retrieval/merge settings via existing service
baseline_sources.mavra: Current Rust implementation, metric-global-full: snapshot regression, condition sharing, optimization and snapshot execution

status_before_execution: Prepared; no paid calls in this cohort.
expected_tasks_per_cell: 23+M; ACE raw max34; selected34 when M=11
domain_adaptation: ACE and AWM use released components through the attributed SQL adapters; G-Memory core is unchanged. Domain-specific failure wording is analytical SQL. Upstream empty transport-error replies are surfaced as adapter failures. All four methods retain common native SQL tools and metadata caches; MAVRA additionally has its native checked metric tools.

feedback_history.scope: same actor; each change restores the post-heldout checkpoint

repairs: Table-owned filter qualification fixes ambiguous shared column names in metric/feature compilation
run_metric compiles stored definitions for model-supplied kinds/periods and retains revision/snapshot checks
Common business-key evidence instruction for all methods; native tool-use guidance for available metric execution
selection: All eleven original scenarios are mandatory, including lossy dates and units. All outcomes on the selected common bank enter accuracy. Original study retained separately; versions are not pooled.
price_policy: Verified weekend off-peak rates; reject outside the frozen weekend window. Carry prior priced usage conservatively and original account baseline; include all new attempts.
question_selection: Fixed five-form cycle (3*phase_index+1+2*slot)%5, affected metric cycle, August and difference holdouts. Historical backfill questions target the affected learning year. No score-based selection.

scenario_extra_count.gate: ACE runs max=11 first on both schemas. Choose the largest M0..11 whose projected remaining full-method cost fits; apply the same M to every arm. ACE second questions outside M remain archived/charged and cannot affect selected tasks after branch restore.

data_changes: None: original generators, templates and reference libraries retained, including known clone-growth and missing-date limitations.
